notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for active and passive regional interaction subscription transitions. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador/FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, dimensional FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and any logical-time implementation. It verifies that a regional interaction declaration can become passive without losing delivery while another active route keeps the interaction relevant, that a retained passive declaration does not create relevance by itself, that an empty region set is a no-op, and that the same non-empty pair restores active delivery. No provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior are required.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador regional interaction publication, active/passive subscription transition, unsubscription, send, and cleanup services with FederateAmbassador receiveInteraction delivery
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador active/passive regional interaction declarations
